body: apps/extension/src/ui/volt holds a COPY of volt-web's shadcn-derived components (button, input, badge, tabs, separator, dropdown-menu, tooltip, switch, table, card, label, collapsible, scroll-area, dialog). Only the import path was changed (@/components/ui/button -> @/ui/volt/button), so a re-sync is a copy plus that sed. Worth revisiting if volt-web ever publishes these as a package.
title: Re-sync volt-web components when the source changes
